claims.claim_text: Puerto Rico is described as having the largest population among oppressed nations in U.S. territories.
Recent U.S. tax-code changes caused thousands of Puerto Rican manufacturing-job losses and contributed to Puerto Rico's then-current economic crisis.
For decades, remediation of environmental damage left by the U.S. Navy on Vieques and elsewhere in Puerto Rico was delayed or left inactive.
